description: Keyboard, pointer, wheel or touch input. press/release take a KeyboardEvent.code (e.g. Space, ArrowLeft, KeyZ), or PointerRight / PointerMiddle for mouse buttons. tap/pointer_down/pointer_move take logical x, y; tap and pointer_down also take kind (mouse, touch or pen). wheel takes dy (and dx) in CSS pixels. touch_down/touch_move take id, x, y (touch_down also kind: touch or pen); touch_up takes id. Input takes effect on the next game_step.

dy.description: For wheel: vertical scroll, positive = down.

kind.description: Pointer kind for tap, pointer_down and touch_down.

name: game_input
title: Send input
